stories.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.simple_summary: Several AI assistants can now work inside text messaging apps like you use on your phone. These tools help with general tasks, planning trips, family coordination, and work projects.
stories.why_it_matters: If you text a lot, this gives you quick access to AI help without opening a separate app. However, you need to decide if you're comfortable letting an AI see your personal messages.

stories.title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
stories.simple_summary: An actor sold the rights to use his face in AI videos to a company that makes short movies. This is becoming popular in China and might spread to Hollywood.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a question for actors and entertainers, not for ordinary people. For now, there's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: Using AI, mathematician claims to have solved one of math’s great mysteries
stories.simple_summary: A mathematician says they used AI to help solve a very hard math puzzle that experts have worked on for a very long time.
stories.why_it_matters: This is exciting for mathematicians and scientists, but it doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: Principal: Juvenile used AI to make nude images of Chatham Co. charter school students & staff
stories.simple_summary: A young person used AI tools to create fake nude pictures of students and teachers at a school. Police got involved.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can be misused to hurt people. Parents and schools need to teach kids about these dangers, and everyone should know this is illegal.

stories.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims to Solve Riemann Hypothesis With Help From Claude
stories.simple_summary: A mathematician working at an AI company called Anthropic claims to have solved a famous 167-year-old math problem using Claude, an AI assistant.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important for math experts and the AI industry to know about. For everyday life, it doesn't change anything.

stories.title: Anthropic may have solved major maths problem Reimann hypothesis
stories.simple_summary: An AI company may have helped solve a major unsolved math problem called the Riemann hypothesis.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to mathematicians and science professionals. It doesn't affect ordinary people or small businesses.

stories.title: Jensen Huang Was Reportedly Fixated on Humiliation
stories.simple_summary: An article discusses how the head of an AI chip company treated people badly, based on reported stories about his behavior.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a story about a business leader's behavior. It's mostly interesting to investors and people who work in tech companies.

stories.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
stories.simple_summary: The president said the government will tax American companies heavily if they build large computer centers for AI outside the United States.
stories.why_it_matters: This could affect where AI companies put their equipment, which might influence AI prices and where new tech jobs appear. Most small business owners won't feel this directly for a while.

stories.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
stories.simple_summary: The founder of Spotify is investing money in a company building fusion power plants. The company was started by someone who also works in AI research.
stories.why_it_matters: Fusion power could eventually provide huge amounts of clean electricity. This is mostly interesting to investors and tech enthusiasts right now.

stories.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
stories.simple_summary: An AI program claims to have solved the Riemann hypothesis, a 167-year-old math mystery. At the same time, a human mathematician also announced a solution.
stories.why_it_matters: This is exciting news for the math world and shows what AI can do. For regular people and small businesses, it's not something you need to act on.

stories.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
stories.simple_summary: The president plans to put heavy taxes on companies that build large AI computer centers outside the United States.
stories.why_it_matters: This policy might make it more expensive for companies to build AI equipment overseas, which could affect tech prices and job locations. Most small business owners won't feel direct effects immediately.

stories.title: If I Could Only Own 1 Trillion-Dollar Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Through 2030, It Would Be Anthropic, Nvidia, or Alphabet. Here’s My Top Pick.
stories.simple_summary: A financial writer says if they could invest in one giant AI company stock until 2030, they would pick Anthropic, Nvidia, or Alphabet, and they explain which one.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investment advice for people with money to invest in stocks. If you're not in the stock market, this doesn't affect you.
